text.offer: Far'Nohl's knights swore to serve him beyond death, and they keep that oath still, in his chambers at the top of the castle. Free ten of them from it.
text.progress: The undead knights guard Far'Nohl's Chambers, at the top of Castle Victoria.
text.complete: Ten oaths broken. They'll rest now, I hope.

steps.objective: Undead knights slain in Far'Nohl's Chambers
